random_vector_policy: Reuse exact saved norm-matched isotropic Gaussian directions from the completed norm_matched_random control.
offtarget_subset_policy: One deterministic fixed subset per source behavior; the target behavior is excluded during calibration. Selection seed does not include model slug.
kl_definition: Mean full-vocabulary next-token D_KL(p0 || p_intervened) at the model-family PromptAdapter scoring position.
matching_policy: For each saved random direction and frozen CAA operating point, beta has the same sign as alpha_star. A sign-specific random KL curve is evaluated only on off-target validation prompts; sqrt(KL) interpolation and optional refinement select beta. Target behavior test data is evaluated only after beta is frozen.
evaluation_split: behavior test after KL matching is frozen
